subject.title: feat(dashboard): sandboxed custom widgets + approval flow [3/3]

question: Should OpenClaw adopt an enabled-by-default bundled dashboard that lets agents author executable browser widgets after the storage, approval-integrity, and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: This introduces a major default Control UI surface and a new execution model for agent-authored browser code; implementation review cannot determine whether maintainers want to own that permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the bundled dashboard
options.body: Accept the direction after SQLite state, immutable approval binding, dependency authorization, and real-browser security proof are complete.

options.title: Narrow to an opt-in plugin
options.body: Keep the plugin disabled by default while the security, approval, and operator UX model matures.

options.title: Pause the initiative
options.body: Defer the stack until maintainers select a different dashboard or custom-widget architecture.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bundled dashboard
recommendation.body: Accept the direction after SQLite state, immutable approval binding, dependency authorization, and real-browser security proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work established the bundled plugin-tab and Control UI direction that this proposal extends.
